data.name: Abbi
data.gender_notes: Abbi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Abh,' meaning 'father.' In the Bible, Abbi may refer to Abbiathar, a priest, or Abbigail, a wise and beautiful woman. Spiritually, Abbi represents strength, wisdom, and loyalty in parenthood and relationships. The name Abbi carries the meaning “Father of many” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abbi usually hope their child will grow to embody father of many and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strong parenthood and wise leadership.
data.etymology: Abbi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of many.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abbi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
